Halv
Make your AI coding plan last twice as long
Every turn, coding agents resend files, diffs, instructions, and logs they have already seen. Halv removes that wasted context locally before each request reaches the model. You can keep the same CLI, login, model, and subscriptions for Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, and GLM while getting far more work from your plan. Halv also includes split terminals, multi-agent workflows, local sandboxing, a Crux code index, command filtering, and a live savings meter with a receipt for every answer.

Sekondo
Your next Adobe tool run by talking to it
Sekondo connects ChatGPT or Claude to Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Lightroom Classic. You tell it what you need, typed or dictated, and it works inside your own files with real layers, text, and styles you can keep editing. It doesn't generate separate images; it works on the real file, with you in charge.
In demos, it translates a 12-page brochure in InDesign in seven seconds and retouches 124 jewelry photos in Photoshop in one second each. Built by a graphic designer since 1992, it runs on macOS and Windows with your Claude or ChatGPT subscription. Ships in October 2026; reserving a seat is free.

InfraGrid 3D
Civil engineering design in-browser with native BIM export
InfraGrid 3D lets civil and MEP teams design underground services and construction-grade roads in the browser. Users can verify routes with live long sections and clash detection, then export native geometry to Revit, Civil 3D, or AutoCAD. It supports pipe banks, drainage, lighting, grading, and LOD 400+ road components, with rapid IFC/DXF input/output and a Revit plugin for live sync. Use it standalone or inside Revit to route, coordinate, and deliver models faster while keeping elements native for downstream drawings.
